title: Etale cohomology is invariant under the localized-site sheaf equivalence
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ and $\mathcal D$ be Grothendieck sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $e:\mathcal C\simeq\mathcal D$ an equivalence of categories whose forward and inverse functors carry covering families to covering families, inducing an equivalence $e_*$ of categories of abelian sheaves. For an object $W$ of $\mathcal C$, an abelian sheaf $G$ on $\mathcal C$, and every $q\geq0$, the equivalence identifies the derived cohomology over $W$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] with that over $e(W)$: $H^q(W,G)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(e(W),e_*G)$. This isomorphism is natural in $G$ and in morphisms of objects $W'\to W$ of $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Cohomology on Sites, Lemma 03F3 (lemma-cohomology-of-open), derived-functor calculation transported by an equivalence of sites (agent extension)

proof.text: Apply covering_iff_of_equivalence to the two covering-preservation hypotheses, obtaining hiff for all W and R.
Apply site_equivalence_is_morphism_of_sites to e.functor, e.inverse, e.unitIso, e.counitIso and hiff. Extract the continuity witness hi' for e.inverse.
Use hi' as the existential witness. For each natural number q apply cohomology_presheaf_iso_fixed_degree with hiff and hi'. This yields exactly the required Nonempty natural isomorphism.
